name: apex-query-validator
description: Validating SOQL/SOSL Queries in Apex Classes Without 'DAO' or 'Test' in Name

apexQueryValidator.exemptFilenameKeyword.description: Lowercase filename substrings that exempt a file from validation (e.g. files with 'dao' or 'test' in their name).

apexQueryValidator.includeGlobs.description: Glob patterns identifying which files should be validated for embedded SOQL/SOSL queries.

apexQueryValidator.diagnosticSeverity.description: Severity level used for SOQL/SOSL findings reported in the Problems panel.

apexQueryValidator.autoValidate.description: Automatically run validation when an Apex file is opened or saved, in addition to running it manually via the command.

apexQueryValidator.daoFilenameKeywords.description: Filename substrings identifying DAO files where SOQL/SOSL queries should be moved. Used to power the Quick Fix suggestion that navigates to the matching DAO.

apexQueryValidator.maxQueriesPerFile.description: Maximum number of inline SOQL/SOSL queries allowed per file before the governor/too-many-queries rule fires.

apexQueryValidator.maxSelectFields.description: Maximum number of fields allowed in a SOQL SELECT clause before the perf/wide-field-list rule fires.

apexQueryValidator.maxSubqueries.description: Maximum number of child (relationship) subqueries allowed in one SOQL query before the perf/too-many-subqueries rule fires.

apexQueryValidator.largeObjects.description: SObject names considered 'large'. A SOQL query on any of these objects without a WHERE clause triggers the perf/unbounded-large-object rule.

apexQueryValidator.enableCorrectnessRule.description: Enable correctness rules that catch guaranteed runtime/compile failures (e.g. a single-row query assignment without LIMIT 1).

apexQueryValidator.enablePerformanceRule.description: Enable performance rules (missing LIMIT, wide field list, SOQL in loop, unbounded large-object query, ORDER BY without LIMIT).

apexQueryValidator.enableSecurityRules.description: Enable security rules (dynamic SOQL string concatenation, hardcoded Salesforce record IDs, unbound string literal in WHERE clause).

apexQueryValidator.enableStyleRules.description: Enable style rules (SELECT Id only, aggregate without GROUP BY, SOSL without RETURNING, deprecated SIDEBAR scope). Style findings are always reported at Information severity.

apexQueryValidator.enableGovernorRules.description: Enable governor-limit rules (too many queries in one file, Database.query() calls, Database.search() / Search.query() calls).

apexQueryValidator.enforceSecurityClause.description: Opt-in: flag inline SOQL queries that do not enforce field/object security via WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED, WITH USER_MODE, or WITH SYSTEM_MODE. Off by default because not every query should enforce sharing/FLS.

apexQueryValidator.quickFixLimit.description: The LIMIT value inserted by the 'Add LIMIT' Quick Fix for queries missing a LIMIT clause.

apexQueryValidator.rules.description: Per-rule overrides keyed by rule id (e.g. "perf/missing-limit"). Each value is "off", "information", "warning", or "error" and takes precedence over the category toggle and the global diagnosticSeverity. A severity value also forces the rule to run even when its category is disabled.
